change_scope: repository governance, CI determinism, unified verification interface, and evidence classification. No runtime, application, database, or provider state is modified.

defect_closed.boundary: mandatory gates ran only on pull-request heads, so the commit that became canonical main was never verified as a whole; main was additionally unprotected

enforcement.third_party_actions_pinned_to_sha: all except actions/setup-python, which could not be verified from this repository-scoped session and is deliberately left on a tag rather than falsely pinned

branch_protection.note: applying branch protection mutates repository administrative configuration and requires its own review; it must not be recorded as enforced without a provider readback

remaining_gates: independent review of this exact candidate head
merge into canonical main with the exact-merge-result gates green
separate production deployment authorization and rollback rehearsal
